snippet.title: Dodo Duckie - Official PC Release Date Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist and try out the demo now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4395280/Dodo_Duckie_Demo/

You’re a DUCK! with one special cap that gives you the power to switch between 2D and 3D. Use it to explore, switch perspectives, solve puzzles and save your chicken friends.

#duck #dododuckie #dodo #duckgame
